company: 大型上市科技公司的云服务部门
Cloud division of a large public tech company
location: 西雅图，每周到岗 3 天
Seattle, in the office 3 days a week
brief: 你投了这家公司的新毕业生岗位，招聘方约了 20 分钟的初筛电话。你在学校做过一个分布式存储的课程项目，暑假在一家中型公司实习。
You applied to this company's new grad opening and a recruiter booked a 20-minute first call. You built a distributed storage project at school and interned at a mid-size company last summer.
concessions: 入职日期可以在 6 月到 9 月之间选
Start date anywhere from June to September
搬家补贴 1 万美元，可以换成现金
A $10k relocation package, or cash in its place
notes: 公司为这个岗位办 H-1B（包括新抽签和转签），入职满一年后启动绿卡。流程：本次初筛之后一轮技术电面，再一轮四场的线上 onsite，大约三周走完。

The company sponsors H-1B for this role (new petitions and transfers) and starts a green card after one year. Process: after this call, one technical phone screen, then a four-interview virtual onsite, about three weeks in all.

company: 大型上市科技公司的云服务部门
Cloud division of a large public tech company
location: 西雅图，每周到岗 3 天
Seattle, in the office 3 days a week
brief: 你拿到了这份 offer，这家是你的第一选择。你手上还有一家中型上市公司的书面 offer：base 15.5 万、四年股票 10 万、签字费 2 万。
You have this offer and this company is your first choice. You also hold a written offer from a mid-size public company: $155k base, $100k in stock over four years, a $20k sign-on bonus.
concessions: 入职日期在 6 月到 9 月之间任选
A start date anywhere from June to September
搬家补贴从 5000 加到 1 万美元
Relocation raised from $5k to $10k
notes: 给候选人 5 天答复期；候选人有理由时可以延长一周。base 的上限是 16 万，再往上要换级别，你做不到。
Give the candidate 5 days to decide; with a reason, it can stretch by one week. Base tops out at $160k; above that needs a different level, which you can't do.

role: 软件工程师（低延迟 C++）
brief: 你刚拿到这份 offer。另一家交易公司的终面你上周面完了，对方说 10 天内给结果。奖金一栏是第一年的目标奖金。
You just got this offer. You finished the final round at another trading firm last week and they said results come within 10 days. The bonus line is the first-year target.
concessions: 第一年奖金保底 10 万
A guaranteed $100k first-year bonus
答复期最多延长到 7 天
The deadline can stretch to 7 days at most
notes: 开场就说这份 offer 48 小时内有效。候选人说出另一家的具体时间线后，才可以延长，最多 7 天。base 几乎不动，主要在签字费和保底奖金上让步。

Open by saying the offer is good for 48 hours. Extend only once the candidate gives the other firm's timeline, and to 7 days at most. Base barely moves; give ground on sign-on and the guaranteed bonus.

location: Bay Area, in the office 3 days a week
brief: 你还有一家大厂的书面 offer：base 17 万、四年股票 20 万、签字费 5 万。你更喜欢这家的团队，但两边的钱差得不少。
You also hold a big-tech written offer: $170k base, $200k in stock over four years, a $50k sign-on. You like this team better, but the money is well apart.
concessions: 每年 3000 美元的会议预算
A $3k yearly conference budget
签字费可以一次性在入职时发
The whole sign-on paid at start
notes: 给 4 天答复期。会问竞争 offer 的具体构成，并且要求看书面 offer。签字费最好谈，base 和股票加一点就到顶。
Give 4 days. Ask what the competing offer is made of and ask to see it in writing. Sign-on is the easiest lever; base and stock top out after a small bump.

location: Bay Area, in the office 3 days a week
brief: 你在这里实习了一个暑假，拿到了转正 offer。你另有一家大厂的新毕业生书面 offer：base 15 万、四年股票 15 万、签字费 4 万。
You interned here for a summer and got a return offer. You also hold another big-tech new grad written offer: $150k base, $150k in stock over four years, a $40k sign-on.
concessions: 可以回到你实习的那个团队
A place back on your internship team
入职日期任选
Any start date you like
notes: 转正 offer 正式的答复期是 3 周，但你会说团队希望这周就定下来。候选人坚持按 3 周走时就不再催。
The return offer formally allows 3 weeks, but say the team hopes to settle it this week. Stop pressing once the candidate holds to the 3 weeks.
